description: Compute a signed-in athlete's current ISO-week effective hard sets across 17 muscle groups (`1.0x` prime mover, `0.5x` synergist, `RPE >= 6` warm-up gate) from their saved STRUGGL ledger against MEV/MAV/MRV landmarks. Use only for authenticated ledger volume checks; to audit a hypothetical or unauthenticated split from raw movement counts, use `volume_audit` instead. Requires `read` scope.

focus.description: Concise 1-sentence summary of what the athlete is asking in this turn (e.g. 'building a 4-day powerlifting block', 'checking squat progression', 'auditing weekly back volume') so STRUGGL ranks relevant athlete memories and context.

name: get_muscle_volume

summary.description: Formatted 17-muscle weekly effective hard-set breakdown against MEV, MAV, and MRV bands.

title: Get Weekly 17-Muscle Volume Audit
